Title: Prohibits the use of adhesive stickers in the enforcement of street parking rules; repealer
Summary: Prohibits municipalities from using adhesive stickers in the enforcement of street parking rules.
LawCode: Add §99-aa, Gen Muni L; rpld & add §19-163.2, NYC Ad Cd
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the general municipal law and the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to prohibiting the use of adhesive stickers in the enforcement of street parking rules; and to repeal certain provisions of the administrative code of the city of New York relating thereto
